subject.text: A wide sheet of tiny grains -- a mackerel sky.

question: Was the sky covered by a thin whitish veil - one you could still see blue through - and if so, did it have any texture?

options.label: yes, a pale veil with streaks or fibres running through it
yes, a pale veil, completely smooth and featureless
no pale veil - either no layer at all, or a grey sheet that hid the blue
